mcp.title: MCP integrations
mcp.note: Connect Mobbin with your Pro, Team or Enterprise account. Sign-in starts in the internal tab and can be completed in your system browser; agents receive tools and previews, never credentials. These integrations apply to this account on this device.
mcp.connecting: Connecting. Complete sign-in in the internal tab or your system browser if requested.
mcp.ready: {name} connected. You can use it in chat.
mcp.browser_note: Protected sign-in: no history or screenshots. To use the accounts in Chrome or your default browser, continue there with the ↗ button. Close this tab to cancel.
mcp.external_note: Sign-in opened in your system browser. Complete it there: AuraChat comes back to the front on its own. Close this tab to cancel.
mcp.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {name} from AuraChat on this device? Local tokens will be deleted and the integration disabled. To also revoke remote consent, use the service's account settings.

mcp.cookies_note: Cookies and sessions persist in your AuraChat account's local browser profile, separate from other accounts and your system browser. They are never imported or synced.
mcp.passwords_note: On Windows, WebView2 provides native password saving: you choose for each site. Passwords are protected by Windows, never read by AuraChat or agents. Turning this off does not delete saved passwords.

Install {name} from {source} for this Windows/macOS user?

AuraChat will run npx skills add globally for Codex. Requires Node.js and Git; downloads third-party software and also makes the skill available to compatible editors. Only install from trusted sources.

chat.handoff_new: Hand off to a new chat
chat.handoff_linked: Hand off to a linked chat
chat.handoff_prompt: Hand this work off to a new, independent chat. Prepare a concise, self-contained handoff (goal, current state, decisions made, files involved, next steps), using the handoff skill if it is available, without saving it to a file. Then call create_chat with a short title and the handoff as the message.
chat.handoff_prompt_linked: Hand this work off to a new chat linked to this one. Prepare a concise, self-contained handoff (goal, current state, decisions made, files involved, next steps), using the handoff skill if it is available, without saving it to a file. Then call create_chat with linked=true, a short title and the handoff as the message.

permissions.title: Change permissions
permissions.ask_description: Asks before writing files or running commands.
permissions.auto_description: Edits project files and automatically reviews commands. Asks for risky or uncertain actions.
permissions.full_description: Files and commands without prompts, including outside the project. Network access with your system account permissions.
permissions.ask_description_chat: Asks before using tools, connectors or web pages. Applies to all chats without a project.
permissions.auto_description_chat: Approves routine actions on its own and reviews the rest. Asks for risky or uncertain actions. Full access requires a project.
errors.permissions_in_use: Wait for running chats to finish before changing permissions.
errors.full_access_requires_project: Full access is only available in projects.
permissions.http_scope: Reads the specified URL without login or cookies. Redirects require a new approval.
permissions.mcp_scope: The MCP server uses its own local access and can read or modify external services. Review the tool and arguments.
permissions.preview_truncated: Preview shortened. The full file exceeds 24,000 characters.
permissions.command_scope: Commands run as your system account without a sandbox: they can access the network and files outside the project.
permissions.review_unavailable: Automatic review is unavailable. You can decide for this action.
permissions.reference_scope: Read-only access to the specified path and, if it is a folder, its files. Only for this chat, until sign-out or quitting AuraChat (hiding the window does not end access). Nothing is added to the project; writes and commands are not authorized. Content read is sent to the configured model.
